summary: Wrote a 7-phase, 8.5-hour plan covering all five agent-system defects, every fix targeted at the resolved source store. The plan is built on the research report's three premise corrections rather than the dispatch's authored text: Defect 2 fails loudly (exit 71), not vacuously, so only the START_RE anchor is fixed; Defect 5's lean manifest carries no routing_hard key, so no free deletion exists; Defect 3 has no existing test suite, so the inline spot-check is extracted to a testable script before its polarity is fixed. Four design decisions are recorded in a Decisions section, including the severity-prefix route for Defect 5 (the addendum's option 1) and why the sanctioned --depends-on-add edge to task 780 is unavailable.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan (3 waves, 8.5h) fixing five agent-system defects in the resolved source store, with per-defect test evidence and a full-gate final phase.
